presumptive._note: Presumptive taxation lets a small business or professional skip detailed books. Profit is deemed to be a fixed share of turnover.

44AD.label: Section 44AD, presumptive scheme for eligible businesses
notes: The 6% rate applies to receipts through banking or electronic channels; 8% otherwise.
Business expenses cannot be claimed separately once this scheme is used.
Opting out locks the taxpayer out of the scheme for the following 5 tax years.

44ADA.label: Section 44ADA, presumptive scheme for specified professionals
notes: Applies to specified professions such as design, legal, medical, engineering and accountancy.
Profit is deemed to be 50% of gross receipts. Expenses cannot be claimed separately.

gst._source: Transcribed from official rate tables for FY 2025-26. NOT YET VERIFIED.
notes: A service provider must register once annual turnover crosses the threshold.
GST paid on business expenses can be set off against GST charged to customers.
Exports are zero-rated: no GST is charged, and input credit may still be claimed.

_gaps: Surcharge on incomes above 50 lakh is NOT implemented. No test fixture reaches that level. Must be added before any real use.
Marginal relief on surcharge is not implemented, for the same reason.
Senior and super-senior citizen slab variations under the old regime are not implemented. All fixtures are under 60.
